sloka: अथर्षभः समुत्पत्य वानरो रावणानुजम्।मत्तानीकमुपागम्य तस्थौ तस्याग्रतो बली ।। ६.७०.५५ ।।
transliteration: atharṣabhaḥ samutpatya vānaro rāvaṇānujam।mattānīkamupāgamya tasthau tasyāgrato balī ।। 6.70.55 ।।

translations.english: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras endowed with prowess, springing up came and stood in front of Mahaparsva.
